decisions.reason: Extending native USB enumeration to the integrated board does not change the ESP32 module model or full-pin-breakout requirements, whose scope already includes the integrated board.
Failure to enumerate even in forced-download mode does not establish a change to the BOOT or reset circuit requirement or extend its scope.
The message confirms that integrated-board power and the 3.3V rail are working; it does not change the modular standalone-USB supply requirement.
The native USB scope change does not alter which rails must be monitored, the monitoring IC, or the unresolved integrated-board monitoring choice.
The source reports native USB enumeration failure but does not revise any GPIO assignment or the scope of the general GPIO-mapping requirement.
Native USB enumeration on the integrated board is independent of the modular I2C pull-up and signal-conditioning requirements.
The source does not change any main-board dimensions, connector placement, orientation, or other mechanical-layout constraint.
The integrated-board native USB scope change does not modify the modular boards' interboard connector topology or pinouts.
The source does not alter the panel-mounted power-button connector, signal connection, control behavior, or modular-main-board scope.
The source confirms successful power-up but does not change the AXP2101 battery or USB power-path requirement.
The same message provides runtime verification that the 3.3V rail works, but the source MODIFY only changes the native USB requirement's scope and does not change DCDC1 regulation state.
The native USB scope change does not modify battery-connector placement, orientation, clearance, spacing, or enclosure accessibility.
